main_text.head: ORDO CAPITVM vel quaestionum in hoc opusculo breviter & perspicuè tractatarum:
main_text.l: 1. An iure Protestantium ecclesiae oppugnent pontificem Romanum, eiusque sectatores & iuratos: iure item ab eorum communione sese segregaverint? pag.1. & seq. item pag.51. & seq.
2. An pii, qui sub magistratu pontificio latent, coetus clandestinos, exercendae verae religionis nomine, contra illius edictum, instituere & fovere queant? pag.33.
3. An iure Protestantes rejiciant auctoritatem concilii Tridentini, & reliquorum, quae ad praescriptum Romanensium instituuntur? pag.65. & seq. item pag.99.
4. An pii moveri debeant banno atque anathematis Romanensium? p.92. etc. item p.121 & seq.
5. Qua ratione viri pii certi esse possint de veritate professionis suae? | p.131
6. An principibus & aliis politicis viris concedi debeat judicium de rebus fidei? | pag.134

page.notes: Numbers 1–6 are the printed list numbers. The entry "7. Utrum" is cut off at the bottom and appears only as the catchword "Utrum"; it is not transcribed as an entry. The faint ghosted text at the top of the page (possibly a running head or show-through) is not legible and is left out. The "pag." references at the right of each line are set in italic. Item 5 and item 6 page references are right-aligned in the printed text. The strip at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is omitted.
